crossRefs.note: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.
“Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,
“Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

translations.web: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!
translations.bsb: Surely you know, for you were already born! And the number of your days is great!
translations.kjv: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
translations.asv: Doubtless, thou knowest, for thou wast then born, And the number of thy days is great!
